latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – manage any Odoo business objects and metadata via XML-RPC with flexible context-aware instance switching.

- Supports generic CRUD operations on all Odoo models using execute_kw.
- Built-in flows and examples for contacts (res.partner) and model introspection.
- Advanced context management: switch Odoo instance, database, or user temporarily or per-session without changing environment defaults.
- Obeys secure credential handling, supporting Odoo passwords or API keys.
- Exposes current connection context (never shows secrets), and allows easy reset to environment defaults.
